statement: The Global Spherical Shell conjecture. Every connected minimal compact complex surface of class VII with $`b_2\gt 0`$ contains a global spherical shell, proving the positive-b2 Global Spherical Shell conjecture. Such a shell is a holomorphically embedded neighborhood of the standard three-sphere in $`\mathbb C^2\setminus\{0\}`$ whose complement is connected.
